executors.description: Query the configured OA document HTTP API for an employee number explicitly supplied by the user.

actions.description: Retrieve one bounded page of OA document metadata, parsed body content and attachment content for the explicitly supplied employee number and date range.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON containing explicit userId, timeRange, optional keyword/text, content flags, pageSize, pageNo and audit reason; never include appId or accCode.

actions.result: agentloop.oaDocData/v1 with the sanitized request, complete upstream JSON response, page coverage and an evidence receipt.
